segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: From the minority, Honorable Iris Montes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good afternoon, Secretary Vins, to the DPWH family and sa atin pong lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, almost two years ago, your appointment came on the heels of a massive corruption scandal in the agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Marami po ang nabigyan ng pag-asa na maibabalik niyo po ang tiwala at kumpiyansa ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Let me take off from the last words of your presentation about your commitment to protecting people's money and building the right infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: But before that, let me first commend you for trying your best to institute reforms in the agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Especially in terms of technical reforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: However, I would like to delve more into financial accountability, transparency, and corruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Nabanggit niyo po kanina may portal, may nagtanong, nabanggit niyo po may portal ang DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Nabanggit niyo rin po na may i-upload kayong mga requirements for projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Can you briefly explain to me what is this portal all about?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Thank you po so much, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Noong pong November of last year, nag-launch po si Pangulo nung Transparency Portal po ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po ay isang website kung saan in-upload po ng DPWH ang lahat ng mga dokumento pertaining to both completed and ongoing projects over the last 10 years.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po ay naging follow-up dun sa isumbong ko.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: sa Pangulo website na ni-launch din po ng Pangulo a few months earlier.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And that has been there for the public, for everyone po, including the media, to look at the projects of DPWH and look at all the documents supporting those projects.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So ngayon po, ito pong portal na ito, ito din po ang gagamitin namin para naman po i-upload.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: yung lahat ng detalye po dito sa 2027 Proposed National Expenditure Program ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And this will include all the supporting documentation for the 11,000 plus projects po of the department.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So yun po, yun po yung ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So it is the initiative of the president.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: It is not from the DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It is from the DPWH po, but upon the instructions given by the president.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So it's being institutionalized now in the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So what do we find in that, yung mga projects, requirements and all?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pag paumanhin niyo po sana, Mr. Secretary, hindi ko po alam ang lahat, pero to my mind, parang maganda po na meron tayo dyan, na ipapakita natin ang proyekto, yung mga requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pero hindi po kaya mas magandang kumplituhin natin yung life cycle ng proyekto, di po ba, from start to finish, and even after completion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: pwede po bang nasa plano po ba ng DPWH na i-institutionalize sa portal na yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Halimbawa po, yung sa procurement and bidding transparency, naka-livestream ba? Pwede ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron bang complete bidding documents na naka-upload?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, pangalawa po, real-time project monitoring.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasi yung real-time project monitoring, mabibigyan ng publiko, ang auditors, at mga stakeholders ng unrestricted access doon po sa portal na yun, at makikita nila ang nangyayari sa proyekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron dyan GIS map, may project location, GU tag photos, et cetera, et cetera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And in terms number three po, financial accountability naman, makikita natin yung budget versus actual cost.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pag merong delay, merong change order logs, di po ba, may mga disbursement records.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And then, yung pang-apat at pinaka-importante po para sa akin, yung contractor and citizen feedback loops.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Dapat nakikita natin yung contractor performance ratings doon, may public and grievance button, di po ba, for reporting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: At meron din parang FOI, Freedom of Information Log, na na-view ng public everything about the project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, if we want to talk about transparency, and if we want to talk about curbing corruption, I think, yung ganito pong pamamaraan is a step towards that direction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Do you agree, and do you believe in that, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Actually po, most of the functionalities that you have mentioned, nandun na po sa portal, if I may give some of them.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: For example, from the bidding of the project,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: nandun po yung live stream nung mga proyekto, especially all ongoing, ano po yan, no?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nandun po yung live stream on the day of the bidding itself, plus the video is actually saved in the portal itself, number one.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Number two po, there is also project monitoring part of the portal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: There are updates po on physical progress of the project using satellite imaging.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We signed po with the Philippine Space Agency to provide us with satellite images every, I think, every quarter para po makikita yung diferensya nung pag-umpisa ng project habang ginagawa po yung proyekto every three months.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron din pong ano yan, lahat po ng bidding documents nandyan, and meron din pong running physical accomplishment, no?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ang wala lang po sa mga na-mention nyo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Which, tama po yung sinabi nyo, kailangan ilagay din is yung disbursement.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi ngayon po, ang meron lang is yung kapag fully paid na siya, no?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero wala po yung progress billing, which I think we should also include there.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But that won't be difficult, I think, to include in the portal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But many of the functionalities po you mentioned are there already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yun lamang po ang aking tanungan at paglilinaw.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And I am hoping during the next...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: budget hearing next year, meron na rin po, umaasa po ako na magkakaroon na kayo ng report tungkol sa portal na po na ito po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kung ano ang nagawa to curb corruption in the agency, kung paano po napabuti ang ahensya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: at kung paano nga po natin tunay na naprotektahan ang pera ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And but I don't think we have to wait po, ma'am, for next budget hearing, I think.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We owe it to Congress and the people that we give maybe a regular quarterly report from now until next year.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We will do that po, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: The next to interpolate is from the majority, and this time it's Honorable Salvalero Plato.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Welcome to Secretary Vince Dizon, our undersecretaries, assistant secretaries, directors, and the officialdom of the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Let me first thank the Honorable Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Upon the request of the President, President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos, Jr.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: the Secretary went to Cagayan de Oro last Thursday and was able, therefore, to see our number one bypass project,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: the Cagayan de Oro Coastal Bypass Road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The last time a Secretary came to visit that project, because we finished Phase 1 already, nine years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we are now in the second phase of the CDO, 14 years after Secretary Vince Dizon came there to see that project, 2012,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: the next Secretary who came to Cagayan de Oro, Secretary Vince, thank you so much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: On behalf of our people, we thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: This is a good 14 years that a Secretary came to see our CDO Coastal Bypass Road

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And thank you for stating that you are going to seek for, because it needs 34 billion pesos, you are going to secure foreign funding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Secondly, we also visited the other bypass road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: If this is the highway, the only highway, diyan kami na sa traffic lot, this is the sea, you also have our eastern interior road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: It only needs about seven billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And so you committed also to help, so that it will ease the traffic of our city.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And third, you have promised that you are going to add 120 million to finish our Makabalan-Bonbon Bridge,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: again, easing the traffic from the second district, which is my district, to the first district of the City of Golden Friendship, Cagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Next, I would like to thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: You see, for the past two congresses, six years na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I've been filing a bill for the feasibility study of the Mindanao-Leite Bridge Interlink Project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: During the BICAM, last December, with our minority leader, we were in the BICAM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And there was no budget for 2026 for the Visayas to Sorsogon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we were able, in that BICAM, we were able, Mr. Secretary, to include 120.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And now you're implementing it for 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And now, because of your magnanimous approach and the President, you have included now, for the first time,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: after six years of our trying to have this, including Chairman Momo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: because this Surigao to Southern Leyte Bridge will go to Dilagat, his proposal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And that is why we hope that this will be implemented.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: It will be implemented soonest for January next year, so that once the study is finished in Visayas to Luzon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: then the next will be Mindanao to Visayas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And Mr. Secretary, this will revolutionize the economic development and social development of Mindanao, the Visayas, and then going to Luzon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Food, food, food products, everything, merchandise.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: People will come, will go by car, by truck, from Mindanao, like Cagayan, Oro City, going to Surigao, going to Southern Leyte, going to Samar, Northern Samar, Sorsogon, and then to Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And I have this letter to be given to you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: This is where the Palarumpa Masa before.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I was looking at your presentation that the renovation of buildings are important.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we're only asking 100 million only.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because there is an agreement between, I was the one who called it, between the provincial governor, Juliet Uy, the mayor of Cagayan, Oro, Clarix Uy, and then this representation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We will start with renovating 300,000, 300 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: 100 million from the city, 100 million from the province, and 100 million from the DPWH, your department secretary, to be able to add to the grandstand and revise that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And lastly, I would like to therefore ask for the another 200 million for our elevated skyway, walkway, walkway

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Hindi lang ang Makati may elevated walkway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Cagayan, the Oro will have one.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And that is because you have given us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: This year, 83 million, and you are, we are asking for 200 million just to be able to get one-third of that because the amount needed, Mr. Secretary, is 570 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So I have here the letter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I'll ask Attorney Kenny DeChavez to give this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And therefore, with that, Mr. Chairman, again, the people of Cagayan, the Oro

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you so much because of what you are doing and the President for the development of infrastructure in Cagayan, the Oro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And I am here to therefore support, Mr. Chairman, to support the budget of DPWH and move for its increase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: si Jeffrey, increase it because we're increasing other departments and you deserve more because you're doing everything.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pwede po bang tumanggi na lang? Hindi po, hindi po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: No, but thank you very much.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I was, as Congressman Rufus said, I was there po in Cagayan, the Oro, and I was in Misamis, Oriental also with D.S. Bambi, Imano, and later on with Congresswoman Karen Lagbas.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We really need to fix a lot of the infrastructure there.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And sayang po, napakaganda po nung CDO Coastal Road, nine years in the making since inumpisan po ni nga Kong Rufus, even when he was mayor also.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And ano po talaga, it's a very important project for Cagayan, the Oro, but also equally important are the, is na Tagalogon Bridge, na talagang dilapidated na po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It's a 50-year-old bridge that needs fixing.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And also, yung bridges din po sa Misamis, Oriental.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, Odiongan all the way going to Butuan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, ano po talaga sa distrito naman po ni Vice Chair.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And we thank po for the ano for the support of Kong Rufus

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: and our and our representatives in Northern Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you again, Secretary.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At makakaasa po kayo, Mr. Chairman, Kong. That won't be the last time I will be visiting. We will visit po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Habang ongoing po yung projects, up until the completion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Rufus. I really agree with the the proposals of Kong Rufus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Lalo ng Cagayan de Oro kasi developing

segments.text: city na talaga ang kagayang dioro kailangan na yan ng infrastructure support

segments.text: tama ang mga hinihinging mga projects ni Cong Rufus sana may maiwan pa sa amin

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Yes. Yeah. Of course, of course, the bridge which, um, of course, si Rufus, si Kong Rufus

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: ang advocate talaga ng connectivity between Manila, ah Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno

segments.text: usapan natin yung isang national comprehensive flood control and drainage plan that should cover

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.text: plan, but it has been done on a per river basin basis.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: The Maguindanao Central Mindanao River Basin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And apparently, when I asked the same question, Mr. Chairman, ito daw po ang recommendation ng ating mga foreign partners to do it, major river basin and then also on a per

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: The fiscal year 2026 GAA Special Provision was titled Special Road Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: The fiscal year 2027-NEP Special Provision No. 10 is now titled Disposition of the Motor Vehicles Users Charge Collection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: The title of the provision was changed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: And the 15 billion that used to be a stand-alone Special Road Fund is now, for Special Provision No. 10, is specifically included under the Asset Preservation Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: So on the face of the fiscal year 2027-NEP, in the PAP schedule that this committee is being asked to approve, a legislator cannot see the Special Road Fund as a separate line.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: It is invisible unless one reads Special Provision No. 10 and knows how to look for it inside the Asset Preservation Program.

segments.text: Kasi diba nakita mo noong dumalaw tayo

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: May isang subdivision kasi doon sa aming distrito

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Sa may brick town po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: pwedeng lagyan ng water detention facility

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: yung mga basketball courts nila doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: kumbaga, itong darating na mga panahon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: nandun ba sa pipeline ng DPWH

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: ang paglalagay ng mga ganitong klaseng proyekto

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: na makakatulong sa mga area sa Metro Manila

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: gaya ng nagawa din sa Bansang Japan

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: again, inununsyo din po ng ating magna pangulo ito

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na talagang magiging priority po ngayon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: is yung mga water detention facilities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi ang problema po talaga natin

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: nung pumasok po kami late last year,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: dahil nga po sa iba't-ibang rason,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ang isa sa mga kailangan natin gawin ngayon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ay yung mga water detention facilities

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: all over NCR and even in other major cities,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: para iimbak po muna ang tubig

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: bago po tumapon sa ating mga waterways.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Alimbawa lang po sa distrito nga po ni Congbong,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ang San Juan River po nung habagat just last Monday,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: umapaw na po ang San Juan River.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kapag po umapaw ang San Juan River,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: wala na pong tatapunan ng tubig ang buong Quezon City halos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Gago na gago na po yung distrito ni Congbong.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, ang challenge lang po talaga,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ay ang right of way for water detention facilities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi ang sikit na po ng Metro Manila,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, kailangan po talaga nating maging mas creative.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kung papayag po yung mga golf course,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kung papayag po yung mga open field,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kasi kailangan po talaga malakihang mga detention facilities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And given the volume of water

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na bumabagsak po sa Metro Manila every year.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, we want to do it.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero right of way po talaga ang malaking problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Yan din ang sinabi ko kasi ang problema mo talaga,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Kaya sa amin sa Paranaque, asinan po dati yan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Kaya iba po yung soil structure namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Sabi nga ni Kong kanina na kailangan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: tignan mo talaga yung background din,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Kaya yun nga yung approach na ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: kasi kaya namin nabanggit yung mga nabanggit namin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: kasi patapos na rin yung JICA-funded na Manggahan control gate structure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Ang outfall niyan sa Laguna Divide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Tatamaan ng Las Piñas, tatamaan ng Mundinlupa, tatamaan ng Paranaque.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Kaya tinatanong ko na rin kanina yung Paranaque spillway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Dahil pag na ito, yung buhos ng tubig ng Marikina, doon na papunta sa amin eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: So, ang sa akin lang, hanggat maaari, kung masimulan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: gaya na sinabi ng Pangulo, kung masimulan na natin yung Paranaque spillway,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: kahit pa ano, mabawas na kami ng ano, magkaka-count down kami ng 10 years

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: bago at least matapos na yan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Yung Paranaque spillway po talaga ay critical diyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dahil yan po talaga ang magpuprovide ng exit sa tubig sa Laguna Lake papunta sa Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dahil po talaga, pag natapos na po yung lahat ng proyekto natin na JICA-funded,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: lalo na sa Marikina area, eh talaga po, at sa western Metro Manila,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: diyan po sa Laguna Divide po, lahat ng bagsak ng tubig.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, critical po talaga ang Paranaque spillway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Last na lang po, Mr. Chair. Papasalamat lang po ko, Secretary, for all the efforts you are doing, not just for the city of Paranaque but also all over the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Nakikita namin yung sipag mo, yung pagsasaga mo, yung inidad mo dahil sa trabaho mong to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Raymund S. Yamsuan
segments.text: Kami, ito, kabatchmate ko si Secretary Vince sa pagpasok sa gobyerno at nakita ko, simula bata pa ko, masipag na ko talaga siya and I appreciate your efforts, not just for everybody but for the whole country. Maraming salamat, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Thank you. Next, from the minority, Congresswoman Renee Ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you po, Mr. Chair, at magandang hapon po sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Department of Public Works and Highways.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siguro magtatanong po muna ako at baha na naman at marami na naman po muling mga iba't ibang repairs and nakita nga natin last year na yung flood control scandal, marami pong mga contractors, questionable yung backgrounds, may ilan po dyan, may promise na titignan kung sila po ay qualified or hindi na magtuloy-tuloy

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ayaw natin na mapunta yung budget natin sa isang contractor na hindi naman po qualified or nakapaghawak ng mga fake, substandard, ghost flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So may I ask, Mr. Chair, Good Secretary, ilang contractors at DPWH project engineers po ba ang formal na na-blacklisted, pinarusahan, o na-demote ang ratings sa nakalipas na dalawang taon dahil sa substandard na kalsada at flood control projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Batay sa Quality Assurance Unit Reports.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, kagaya po nung nasabi kanina, there are 12 contractors that have been blacklisted already. These have all been subject... nasa Ombudsman na po ang mga, lahat ng impormasyon nitong mga ito, marami na pong na-file-an ng kaso at meron pa, according to Ombudsman Remulla po, ay marami pang parating.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: In terms of DPWH personnel, mahigit isandaan na po ang either na suspend, natanggal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At meron pa po kaming mga i-announce sa mga susunod na linggo na next batch.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari din po bang ma-transmit through this committee yung listahan na ito?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Iyan po. Papalaga po namin exacto yung mga pangagan at mga kumpanya na nakasuhan at na-refer sa ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi ko po alam kung natanong na kanina pero last year din napatampok na kailangan ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Master Plan for Flood Control, particularly sa Metro Manila pero sana sa buong Pilipinas. May progress na po ba doon?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Opo. Maraming salamat po, Kong Renee.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nasabi po kanina na ang NCR Master Plan, updating of the NCR Master Plan will be completed by early next year or end of this year.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero in the meantime po, kasi hindi naman po tayong, hindi gagalaw, no, dahil grabe po yung baha sa NCR,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ginagamit po natin ngayon at nakikipag-coordinate po tayo sa iba't ibang mga LGUs sa kanilang local drainage master plans

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: para po, like you said po, hindi katulad nung dati na meron po mga proyekto na lang na pinuponduan at iniimplement na walang plano,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ito po ay naka-coordinate na po sa mga current LGU Master Plans habang po hinihintay natin yung final NCR Master Plan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ganon din po ang ginagawa natin dun sa mga iba't ibang major river basins.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Nagkaroon po ako ng opportunity, Mr. Chair, na mag-interpelate din sa COA kahapon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Na-mention po nila na actually since 2016 pa daw po, fin-lag na po nila sa DPWH na in their audits of the projects and flood control mechanisms na dumadaan sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dapat may Master Plan. 2016 pa daw po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito ibig sabihin 10 years have passed since they've flagged that and

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Up to now ay wala pa rin Master Plan that we can speak of.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ano po bang timeline para po matapos yung mga Master Plan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At siguro baka pwede pong matanong din, meron po bang any efforts na magkaroon ng Master Plan prior po to last year?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron naman pong Master Plans ng lahat ng 18 major river basins.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Isusumiti po namin ito sa inyo at sa komite.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Marami po dito ay kailangan i-update.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero ang latest po natin, dahil nga po pinapamadali ko po ang mga ito, is by next year, mid-next year, updated na po lahat itong 18 major river basin Master Plans na ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At magre-report po kami agad sa Kongreso sa status po nito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At isusumiti po natin yung mga Master Plans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, syempre gets naman natin na nag-iiba ang mga daloy ng ating mga ilog, etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero fin-lag naman po yan ng COA noon pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Dahil po, then and up until now, may identified silang mga flood control projects na taliwas dun sa kanilang purpose yung nagagawa nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang identification yung DPWH ng aling bang projects yung yun yung nangyayari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At kaya po, kailan ba ito pwede matanggal or ma-overhaul para hindi na po nagagawa yun?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron po. In fact, kasama po yan sa ongoing audit natin with the other investigators.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And in fact, meron na po kaming mga napatunayan na hindi masyadong nakakatulong.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And in fact, tinanggal na po namin yung iba dito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At meron din po kaming mga na-identify na mga hindi namang kailangang ituloy na kahit na nagawa.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Halimbawa po, yung sa Bungabong sa Mindoro.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero, ito pong subject ng kaso ni former congressman Zaldico.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Yan po, ang recommendation na po ng ating experts ay hindi na po ituloy yun.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, ito din po ang basis ng kaso ni former congressman Zaldico na ngayon ay pending sa Sandigan Bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, tuloy, gano po kaya kabilis pwedeng matanggal yung ganitong mga proyekto?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Dahil nakakapinsalan na sila, di ba?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Hindi po gano'ng kadali, Mr. Chairman, Madam Congressman.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dahil po, kailangan po ito talaga ma-establish muna na ito'y hindi nakakabuti o ito'y hindi kailangan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kailangan po itong mabigyan ng proper COA clearances para either hindi na ituloy or gibain.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi alam nyo naman po na straight to po ang COA dyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Hindi po tayo pwedeng basta-basta nalang magigiba ng mga proyektong pinagkagalagay.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Gastos na ng pera ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero tuloy-tuloy po kami dito at nakakainip lang po talaga at medyo masalimut yung proseso pero tuloy-tuloy po kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kung maaari pong masumite rin po sa komite yung mga na-identify na pong mga proyekto na nakakapinsala at pwede po at sana naka-line up na tanggalin na po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Opo, magsasubmit po kami, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My next line of questioning naman po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, tungkol naman po sa ating mga pedestrians and commuters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can I ask po, magkano po ba ang opisyal na kabuoang halaga ng bike lane project for 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: EDSA pedestrianization and bike lane project.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito pong expansion ng pedestrian walkways natin along EDSA.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ang total project cost po nito ay 6 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: End to end na po yan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po yung original na 17 billion peso EDSA rehab project na pinababa po natin ang cost at dati po kasi wala pong pagpapalawak ng pedestrian lane yung original EDSA rehab project.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero pinadagdag po natin yan dahil talaga pong kailangan i-prioritize na finally ng DPWH ang pedestrians at ang commuters at ang minimum pedestrian width.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Na po natin for EDSA will be a minimum of 2.8 meters with a maximum of, in some areas, 5 meters.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dati po, ang average pedestrian walkway width po sa EDSA ay parang nasa wala pang isang metro.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: In some cases, 0.3 meters lang po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At nakikita naman po natin ang...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ang nagiging epekto po sa paggamit ng ating mga commuters at pedestrians.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Opo, dahil po, according nga po sa Philippine Development Plan, up to 2023 to 2028, pedestrians and cyclists will be accorded the highest priority in the hierarchy of road users.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero, and pwede na po siguro i-flash yung slide na gusto ko pong makita ng publiko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is from the Manila Bike Community.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung improved na bike lanes that in-implement this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And so, kung titignan natin, tinanggal din po yung mga bollards, tinanggal po yung mga iba't-ibang protections for bike lanes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: To the point na, asan ba yung bike lane?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Very far cry from the standard na sinabing 2 meters for the pedestrian lane.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And baka po pwede matulong, ano po ba yung standard na bike lane?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Um, length na dapat po meron po sa saan?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ang ginamit po namin minimum for the bikes is 1.5 meters.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ang problema rin po taga ka sa, lalo na sa EDSA, no?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At sa ibang mga major roads natin, tulad ng C5,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: is yung space naman po para sa carriageway, yung dinadaanan po ng mga sasakyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Congresswoman, believe me po, this is...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Literally a personal fight for me.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ako po'y siklista at ako po'y very, very strong advocate ng wider sidewalks.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero po talagang, ano no, minsan po talagang limited tayo by space.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kung ako po ang tatanungin, pipigit ko po na 5 meters ang ating pedestrian sidewalk sa EDSA

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: at sa lahat ng major roads.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Magkano na po bang nagastos sa

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I will try po to, ano no, to separate yung ano...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Right now po kasi it is part of the total rehab project.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero I couldn't agree more with you, Madam Congresswoman.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But unfortunately po, minsan po talagang literally, ako po'y nakikipag-away na sa ibang sektor.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi nga po, pagka po talagang sinagad natin ang ibawa ng 5 meters ang pedestrian,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: as per standard, no, international standard, magbabawas po tayo ng lane na sa mga sasakyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, yun po ang pinipilit po namin ibalanse.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero kahit pa paano po, kahit para sa akin personally, kulang pa.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero halos may git-dobre na po ang width ng ating sidewalks sa EDSA ngayon under the current.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Lalo na po sa Ortigas area kung saan talagang heavy ang traffic.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pag umabot tayo doon, parang ang Ortigas po ay aabot ng mahigit 4 na metro

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ang magiging width ng sidewalk doon compared to, I think, 1.5 meters lang po ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi lang po nasagot yung tanong na magkano na po ang naigasta.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I-double check ko lang po, Ma'am. Kasi po, yan po ay magkasama doon sa pag-aayos din po nung daanan ng sasakyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ipasumite na lang din po sa committee ng mga figures na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And gusto ko lang din po i-point out na sa total din po na 644 billion na budget ng DPWH,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

Hopefully po, by next year po matatapos na rin po tayo. Finally po, doon sa ating foreign-assisted project sa Marikina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Malaking bagay po. Isa pa po pala, tungkol naman pala ito, maiba ko naman, ito tungkol sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: tungkol naman pala ito, maiba ko naman, ito tungkol sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Nabasa ko rin rito, gusto po nyo, tungkol dun sa clustering ng school, di ba ngayon ay tuloy-tuloy ang, alam naman natin ang shortage ng classroom, more or less from 160,000 ngayon 150,000 na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ang gusto po naman natin kasi mapabilis natin na magamit ng mga syudyante, sapagkat nakikita naman po natin kasi, Mr. Chair, Apu, Sekretary, yung mga amphitheater sa mga school ay nagagamit ng halos 6 na section, 7 sections, pero ngayon ay nababawasan na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ngayon ang tanong po natin, paano ba yung clustering na ginagawa po ngayon by region?

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kasi may nagparating din na isang malaking problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Sa isang project na apat na distrito magpagsasama-sama, apos i-implement ng nag-iisa na mayroong, sa isang project na mayroong 57 na sites, ano ho bang masasabi nyo rito? Mas mapapabilis ba siya o ano ho mas maganda?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Opo, ang ginagawa po natin ngayon, parang nga po naghanap tayo ng mga panibagong paraan para mapabilis ang pagpapagawa ng classroom, meron po tayong ginagawang clustering, pero site per site.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron pong mga site na mahihirap puntahan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Yun po, ika-cluster po natin doon para masigurado po natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na talaga pong magagawa ng mabilis yung mga areas na yun.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Importante din po yung clustering dahil po pag nagkoconsolidate po tayo,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: then mas na i-insure po natin yung bilis at yung quality din po ng pagpapagawa.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero depende din po ito sa mga site.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Halimbawa po kung merong mga area na mountainous,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: halimbawa po sa Cordillera po, dun sa area po ni Congressman Domogan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pwede po natin i-cluster yung mga marayong lugar

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: para po mas madaling maabot ng mga kontratista yung mga area at sanay sa lugar.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So very ano naman po ito, very, wala naman pong hard and fast na rule dito

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: at nag-a-adjust lang po tayo with the end goal na mapabilis at ma-insure na maayos ang pagkagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: At saka magamit po agad ng ating mga…

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: At magagamit po agad ng ating mga…

segments.text: Sana matignan nyo, ma-revisit nyo lang po, Aposagatari.

segments.text: Ito, napag-usapan po natin parate na tungkol po dun sa repair,

segments.text: tungkol sa constructions, ng maharlika natin, yung daan 001,

segments.text: at saka yung mga iba pa po.

segments.text: Ang isa po sa hindi po natin napapansin, Mr. Chair, Aposagatari,

segments.text: tungkol po dun sa mga overloading,

segments.text: eh, ang totoo niya, kahit gaano kalalim po yung gawin natin,

segments.text: gaano kakapal ka ko sana yung mga 311 natin na yan,

segments.text: Ang tanong po dyan, ilan na po ba yung medyo na…

segments.text: Nabigyan po natin ng pansin, Mr. Chair, Aposagatari.

segments.text: Di ba magastos, di po ba?

segments.text: Maraking problema po talaga ito, Mr. Chairman.

segments.text: In fact, nung ako po yung nasa Department of Transportation pa,

segments.text: talaga pong sakit ng ulo po ito,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: dahil it's really a big enforcement problem.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At tuloy-tuloy po ang pagdulog natin.

segments.text: kay Secretary Janvic, kay Chief PNP, at sa ating mga LGUs

segments.text: na talaga mag-impose po tayo ng strict enforcement nung ating overloading.

segments.text: Mr. Chairman, sasabihin ko lang po, si Congressman Tan po,

segments.text: taga Isabela at sa Northern Luzon,

segments.text: Diyos ko po, yung pong ating mga tulay dyan, number one victim po

segments.text: Talaga pong kailangan po talaga ma-enforce natin ang mabuti.

segments.text: Kaya yun ho, kaya sana ay ma-impose natin,

segments.text: strictly ma-impose natin para at least

segments.text: Opo. Dudulog po tayo sa ating law enforcement agencies

segments.text: Para at least, hindi masayang ang pera ng taong bayan.

segments.text: kung di ho natin naman talaga i-limit yung load ng mga sasakyan.

segments.text: Again and again, Sal, thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan

segments.text: Pero ang galing, ang galing ng mga tanong.

segments.text: malapit na. Malapit na tayong matapos.

segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Hindi po ako magtatanong.

segments.text: Kaya lang sa tagal ng tanong ni Kong Joseph,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, actually, nandito lang po ako para magpasalamat,

segments.text: i-congratulate si Secretary Vince under his watch.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Hindi po biro yung pinagdaanan ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, palakpakan niyo po yung mga sarili ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: DPWH, you deserve a round of applause.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Kasi, ah, I was thinking nung nag-umpisa si Sec. Vince,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Whether ma-accept ng buong DP institution,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: galing din po ako sa gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: It's so hard to introduce reforms.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: But, ah, I must say na at this time, medyo the dust settle.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Medyo tanggap na po yung mga reforms.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Tuloy-tuloy na yung trabaho ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And then, ah, si Mr. Actionman, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Mr. Actionman na tawag natin kay Sec. Vince.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: O kaya huwag kayong magtataka na mas mukha siyang matanda sa akin.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Mas bata ho ako. Mas bata ho siya sa akin.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Actually, pag pinapanood ko siya, parang nakikita ko na yung sitwasyon ng buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And, hindi, sa totoo lang to, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Ah, binibisita niya yung mga lugar na hopeless.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Witness po ako niyan doon sa lugar ko, no?

segments.text: Ah, used to be my district. Nasira yung daan.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Eh, niyaya po niya akong lumipad.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, sinamaan ko po siya at nakita ko yung, nakita niya yung lugar.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Dinala ko siya doon sa ibang lugar na kailangan tapusin.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Ah, fortunately, ah, nabigyan niya naman ng pondo na

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: he made sure na yung mga nabisita niya at kailangang ayusin, naiayos, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So I'll give it to Sec. Vince,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: At alam ko naman, under your watch, wala nang perang masasayang.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Wala nang ghost project, wala nang substandard.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Everybody now is aware na ang publiko ay talagang nagbabantay na bawat piso na mapupunta sa DP ay pakikinabangan ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And I'm, ako mismo, I'm confident, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Hindi lang naman ako, maraming namang nakaka-witness dyan.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Na, ah, pasensya ka na, Sec. Vince.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Tuwing budget, feeling ng lahat, savior of the universe ka.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Pero alam naman natin, hindi naman kaya ang lahat.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Doon lang sa talagang, ah, tama, practical, reasonable, and, ah, napaka-importanting project na pakinabagan ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, again, congratulations to the DP family.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Ah, I hope you continue all these reforms.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And, ah, mapakita sa publiko na,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: karapat-dapat na pagkatiwalaan ang Department of Public Works and Highways.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Bago ko pala i-end yung speech ko, nagpapasalamat ako at sana huwag mo kalimutan ang distrito ko.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Opo. Ah, Mr. Chairman, papasalamat po ako kay, ah, Senior Deputy Speaker.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ah, basta po, with, with your support po, and, ah, lalong-lalo na po ang supporta ng Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Thank you so much, ah, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: I'll, I'll just make it, ah, short for our Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: But, ah, before I begin, may commend the Department, once again, for the reforms na introduced,

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: especially, ah, the flood mitigation programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: May saludo ko kami sa Departamento ho talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ako yung Congressman ng probinsya ng Nueva Vizcaya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And, ah, Nueva Vizcaya is known as the gateway of the Cagayan Valley

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Alam mo ninyo, the last budget deliberation, may request ho kami ng widening ng national roads.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: At ongoing na ho siya. Thank you so much, ah, ah, Secretary, ah, ah, Vince.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: But then, ah, our, ah, problem now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Is, ah, yun hung, ah, location kasi yun ng Nueva Vizcaya talagang, ah, marami hung cargo trucks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: All through the region, ah, region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ah, we know the movement of goods is important to the economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And continuous passage of heavy and potentially overloaded trucks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Also contributes to the premature deterioration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And wear and tear of our roads and bridges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Now, ah, ah, the way the public would see.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Dahil hung, ah, ah, dahil sa mga overloads, yung mga trucks natin, overloading.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Eh, makikita ng publiko na para ang bilis na masira yung roads.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And they would have the public opinion that's, ah, dahil ang bilis, is substandard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Eh, ang cause pala nito is the overloading ng mga trucks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: May we know now, Secretary, kung what possible...

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ah, DPWH, ah, executive action ang gagawin nun natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Taking into account, siyempre, yung Republic Act 8794 on the Anti-Overloading Law or Motor Vehicle Users' Charge Act.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, no, ah, ah, like I said po kanina, no.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Talagang, nung DOTR pa lang po ako, talagang, grabe na pong problema ito, no, itong overloading, no.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At, ah, lalo ko pong nakita ito nung, ah, nung, ah...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na ako'y napasok po sa DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dahil po yung ating N1, yung Maharlika.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Talaga pong yan po ang laging nasisira dahil sa overloading, no.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At hindi lang po yung Maharlika, kundi po yung mga tulay po natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: No, na, nasabi nga din po ni Kong Joseph.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At, ah, ako po ay talagang ano, no, tuloy-tuloy po ang pagdulog ko.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At, ah, ah, para po ma-enforce na po natin talaga itong anti-overloading natin, no.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi po talagang ano, eh, kailangan...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi kung hindi po natin gagawin ito, talagang paulit-ulit lang po tayong mag-aayos ng kalye

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At ang problema po talaga dyan, ang tulay.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi po, ang tulay eh nasira at naputol.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Eh, talagang grabe po ang perwisyo niyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At bago po yan maayos, eh napakatagal po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Buwan po ang bibigangin, minsan taon ang bibigangin bago maayos ang mga tulay.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kaya po, ah, kaisa niyo po ako, ah, ah, Kong.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I will do my best po para, ah, ma-push po natin ang, ah, magtulungan po ang ating law enforcement

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: para talagang ma-enforce natin ang ating anti-overloading, ah, regulations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Thank you so much, ah, ah, Sec. Vince.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: I'm, I'm sure under your leadership, eh, lalo hong nating, ah, mapapaiting itong, ah, implementation ng anti-overloading law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And, ah, if possible, siguro, pwede ho nating, ah, malagyan o...

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ah, ah, sa additional weighing facilities dun sa area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ah, kung pwede ho malagyan tong para ma-streaker implementation nung matas ko natin.

segments.text: Opo. In fact, marami po tayong pinapabiging mga weighing scale na dagdag para po makapag-deploy tayo sa iba't ibang region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Isa ho sana sa Nueva Vizcaya.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron, meron daw po. Papadala po

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ng ating bagong regional director sa region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Ah, Nueva Vizcaya, it's, ah, it composes 15 municipalities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Agricultural communities, kailangan ho ng mga bridges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Eh, yun ho sa construction of bridges, ah, is it possible na by phasing or multi-year nang gagawin natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: O pwede hong minsanan na lang?

segments.text: Unfortunately po, no, kahit gusto po natin ang minsanan, eh, medyo unang-una marami pong tayong bridges na kailangan ayusin.

segments.text: At medyo mahaba din po ang pagsasayos.

segments.text: Gumagampas po madalas ng isang taon yan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, ang suggestion po natin moving forward from 2027,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: imbes na po phasing, eh mag multi-year appropriation lang po tayo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Para kung meron po tayong simulang i-rehabilitate na tulay,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: siguraduhin po natin na yung succeeding years mapondohan para po alam natin kung kailan matatapos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At masigurado po ang pondo sa mga susunod na taon.

segments.text: Thank you so much for making that clear.

segments.text: And lastly, eh, request na lang.

segments.text: Ah, request namin if, ah, for the construction of pedestrian overpass within the Maharlika Highway.

segments.text: And may request na ho kami last time. May pondo na ho for the implementation this year.

segments.text: And for next year, kung pwede ho, is only, ah, ah, two more pedestrian overpass

segments.text: because, ah, there are incidents of, ah, accidents and safety risks within the area dito sa National Highway in Bonfal East Bayumbong

segments.text: and at the same time in Barangay Balete

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Eh, I will just, ah, submit din sa the necessary documents before the Regional Director.
